summary: Repaired the concise study for SYN-001 to SYN-003 and cleared advisories SYN-004 to SYN-007, adding no new source, locus or quotation. Chrysostom on Ps 129:1, Bede on Mk 11:25 and the closing moral senses now credit each Father only with his own clause. A re-read of every Father-naming sentence against the expansive study and the sources fixed seven more instances of the same class (allegory and moral rows, Hilary's smallness, Ambrose's order, Aquinas on in virtute, Jerome/Ambrose on the leaven in the themes and overview). Chrysostom's sentence is now cited to Hom. in 1 Thess. 1, and the unused Bede on Mk 4:30-32 locus and the untrue scope sentence are corrected. Changed: sections/concise/02-overview.tex, 04-themes.tex, 10-commentary.tex, 90-apparatus.tex, generation-metadata.tex, research/production-review.md. All synthesis preflight checks pass. The 12-page author proof keeps pages 1, 2, 3-4 and 5 in place. SYN-008 and the references-used tool observation remain for their owners.
